_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

model_y.basis: Model Y in Texas, installed annual capacity, more than this many

cybertruck.basis: Cybertruck, installed annual capacity, more than this many

cybercab.basis: Cybercab, installed annual capacity, more than this many

vehicle_rows.basis: computed: vehicle rows under the Texas label, counted

model_y_to_cybercab.basis: computed: the Model Y floor over the Cybercab floor, a whole multiple

unit.basis: computed: one drawn block stands for this many thousand of installed capacity

model_y_blocks.basis: computed: blocks in the Model Y row at one block per Cybercab floor

cybercab_blocks.basis: computed: the Cybercab row is one block at that scale

cybertruck_blocks.basis: computed: the Cybertruck row at the same scale

megapack_gwh.basis: Megapack in Texas, GWh of installed annual capacity

cells_gwh.basis: 4680 cells in Texas, more than this many GWh

cortex1_mw.basis: Cortex 1 in Texas, more than this many MW of training compute

cortex2_mw.basis: Cortex 2, more than this many MW of training compute

cortex_texas_mw.basis: computed: the two Texas Cortex floors summed, more than this many MW

plan_mw.basis: the year end plan for training compute, with no location

other_mw.basis: other compute excluded from the Cortex rows, location not given

mw_per_row.basis: a drawing rule: one server row stands for this many MW, so each hall's rows are its floor over this

cortex1_rows.basis: computed: Cortex 1 floor over the drawing rule

cortex2_rows.basis: computed: Cortex 2 floor over the drawing rule

optimus_texas_capacity.basis: the Texas Optimus row's capacity cell is a hyphen, drawn as an empty bay

hours_start.basis: operating hours begin at this hour of the morning

hours_open.basis: computed: from the start hour to midnight

hours_closed.basis: computed: midnight to the start hour

fab_year.basis: the year Tesla plans to start commissioning equipment at the Austin Fab

fab_machines_placed.basis: computed: equipment commissioning is planned and not begun, so no machine is drawn on a pad

population.basis: NHTSA's estimated population for the audit query, never a count deployed

controls_missing.basis: computed: the conventional manual controls NHTSA names as absent, counted

audit_opened_day.basis: the day of the month the audit query opened

texas_rows.basis: computed: the Texas rows of the manufacturing table the claims quote, counted

production_rows.basis: computed: of those rows, the ones whose status reads Production, counted

construction_rows.basis: computed: of those rows, the ones whose status reads Construction, counted

gwh_per_unit.basis: a drawing rule: one battery enclosure on frame 4 stands for this many GWh, stated in its dek

megapack_units.basis: computed: the Megapack row's GWh over the drawing rule, enclosures drawn
